summary: Spike in overlimit rejects after credit limit migration
description:
Since the credit limit migration on 2024-07-05 the posting job has been rejecting about 3% of daily transactions with reason 102 (overlimit). The DALYREJS generation for 07-07 has 4,812 rows.

Root cause: the migration loaded ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT in cents instead of dollars for 1,900 accounts, so CBTRN02C compared balances against limits 100 times too small.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: Fixed the data with a one-off correction job. Reprocessed the rejected transactions on 07-09.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: Added a reconciliation check on credit limits to the release checklist.

summary: Implement fee computation in the interest job
description:
Paragraph 1400-COMPUTE-FEES in CBACT04C is an empty stub with the comment 'To be implemented'. The Interest Calculation Design page says late and over-limit fees are calculated there, but no fee transactions are ever produced.

Acceptance criteria:
- Late fee posted when the minimum payment is missed.
- Over-limit fee posted once per cycle.
- Fees written to SYSTRAN like interest.

comments.author: Daniel Okafor
comments.body: The Confluence page is wrong today. Flagging so nobody relies on it until this ships.

summary: Sign-on compares passwords in plain text
description:
COSGN00C reads SEC-USR-PWD from USRSEC and compares it directly with the password typed on the screen. Passwords are stored unhashed in the USRSEC file (layout in CSUSR01Y, an 8-byte field).

We should store a hash and compare hashes, and add a lockout after 5 failed attempts.

comments.author: Sofia Alvarez
comments.body: Security review agreed this is high priority.

comments.author: Sofia Alvarez
comments.body: Lockout needs a new counter field, so CSUSR01Y changes too. COUSR01C and COUSR02C must be recompiled.

summary: Duplicate transaction IDs from concurrent bill payments
description:
Two customers paid bills in the same second and COBIL00C produced the same transaction ID for both. The program reads the last record in TRANSACT, adds one, and writes the new record, so two tasks can read the same last ID.

The second write failed with a duplicate key and the customer saw an error, but their balance had not been updated, so no money was lost.

The account expiry field in copybook CVACT01Y is spelled ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE. It is used by CBTRN02C for reject reason 103 and by the export copybook CVEXPORT.

Renaming it means recompiling every program that copies CVACT01Y.

comments.author: Priya Nair
comments.body: Not worth the recompile risk. Closing as won't do; documenting the spelling instead.

summary: Accounts with a missing disclosure group silently get the DEFAULT rate
description:
When an account's group ID has no row in DISCGRP, the interest job logs 'DISCLOSURE GROUP RECORD MISSING' and uses the DEFAULT group. Nobody reads that log, so 212 accounts were charged the default rate for three months.

Proposal: write these accounts to an exception report instead of only displaying a message.

comments.author: Daniel Okafor
comments.body: Finance confirmed the DEFAULT rate is higher than most group rates, so customers were overcharged.

summary: Add a Statements option to the main menu
description:
The main menu does not call programs by name in its code. COMEN01C reads its options from a table in copybook COMEN02Y (option number, label, program name, user type) and does EXEC CICS XCTL to the program named in the chosen row.

To add an option we add a row to COMEN02Y, bump the option count and recompile COMEN01C.

comments.author: Sofia Alvarez
comments.body: Note for the graph team: static analysis will not see these XCTL targets, because the program name comes from data.

summary: CREASTMT abended S0C7 in statement step
description:
Step STEP040 of CREASTMT (program CBSTM03A) abended with S0C7 at 02:14. A transaction loaded by a manual fix had spaces in TRAN-AMT.

Recovery: corrected the record in TRANSACT and reran CREASTMT from the top. Statements went out two hours late.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: Postmortem action: validate numeric fields in any manual data fix job.

description:
Customers can only pay their full balance today. Product wants an amount field on the bill payment screen (BMS map COBIL00) so customers can pay part of it.

Impacts the bill payment program, the COBIL00 map and its copybook.

summary: Transaction report request from the online menu
description:
The report screen (CORPT00C) builds JCL for the TRANREPT procedure and submits it through the internal reader. The batch report program CBTRN03C then produces the report.

This ticket added the monthly and yearly options next to the custom date range.

summary: Nightly batch overran into the online window
description:
On 03-10 the nightly batch finished at 07:40, after the online region opened at 07:00. The posting job ran 50 minutes longer than usual because DALYTRAN was three times its normal size after a holiday weekend.

The files stayed closed, so users could not sign on until OPENFIL ran.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: Added an alert if the posting job is still running at 05:00.

summary: Document the interest formula for auditors
description: Auditors asked how monthly interest is calculated. Answer: category balance times the annual rate, divided by 1200, per transaction category, with the rate looked up by account group in the disclosure group file.
